snippet_primary: "Even at my highest point — 17 patrons — and later when I closed it with four remaining, I realized something important: the people who stayed were there for me, not just the content. That meant a lot. But it also revealed something deeper. The model itself wasn't aligned with how I create. I don't create best from obligation. I create best from clarity and energetic overflow. Over time, Patreon began to feel more like maintenance than expansion."
